mechanics.claim: If the sprung box attacks only one target, it deals increased damage (the single-target tick value instead of the AoE value).
mechanics.quote: If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage.

mechanics.claim: Boxes deal bonus magic damage to monsters and 50% reduced damage to structures (dummy in a champion fight is unaffected by either modifier).
mechanics.quote: ''Boxes'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}} and 50% reduced damage to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: The box is invulnerable and untargetable to enemies while stealthed, becoming vulnerable only once revealed.
mechanics.quote: The ''box'' is {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies while stealthed.

mechanics.claim: Once sprung, the box automatically fires at nearby visible enemies every 0.5 seconds, each attack being a separate magic damage instance.
mechanics.quote: it will automatically fire at nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each attack
